elements.text:
During today's class, you have to present in front of your classmates and professor. You've been struggling to put this presentation together, but you haven't reached out to your professor about it yet. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: My professor will think that my presentation needs improvements, and I'll be OK with that.
My classmates will think that I prepared well for the presentation.
My grade will be at risk if I mess up this presentation.
I am hardworking, and my professor will be able to tell.
I won't perform my best today, but I'm allowed to have an off day sometimes.
